chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الْبُرَاثِيُّ وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ حَامِدٍ الْكَشِّيَّانِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَزْدَادَ، عَنْ أَبِي زَكَرِيَّا، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ. مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزْدَادَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ نَعْمَانَ، عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Burathi and Uthman ibn Hamid al-Kashshiyan from Muhammad ibn Yazdad, from Abu Zakariyya, from Ismail ibn Mihran. Muhammad ibn Yazdad from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Nu'man, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr who said:

chunks.arabic_text: كُنْتُ عِنْدَ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فَأَمْسَيْتُ عِنْدَهُ، قَالَ: فَقُلْتُ: أَنْصَرِفُ، فَقَالَ لِي: لَا تَنْصَرِفْ فَقَدْ أَمْسَيْتَ، قَالَ: فَأَقَمْتُ عِنْدَهُ، قَالَ: فَقَالَ لِجَارِيَتِهِ هَاتِي مُضْرَبَتِي وَوِسَادَتِي فَأَفْرِشِي لِأَحْمَدَ فِي ذَلِكَ الْبَيْتِ، قَالَ: فَلَمَّا صِرْتُ فِي الْبَيْتِ دَخَلَنِي شَيْءٌ فَجَعَلَ يَخْطُرُ بِبَالِي مِنْ مِثْلِي فِي بَيْتِ وَلِيِّ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى مِهَادِهِ، فَانَادَانِي يَا أَحْمَدُ، إِنَّ أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَادَ صَعْصَعَةَ بْنَ صُوحَانَ، فَقَالَ يَا صَعْصَعَةُ لَا تَجْعَلْ عِيَادَتِي إِيَّاكَ فَخْرًا عَلَى قَوْمِكَ وَتَوَاضَعْ لِلَّهِ يَرْفَعْكَ اللَّهُ

translations.en: I was at the place of al-Rida (peace be upon him) and evening fell while I was with him. He said: I said, 'I should leave.' He said to me, 'Do not leave, for it is evening.' He said: So I remained at his place. He said: He said to his slave-girl, 'Bring out my sleeping tent and my pillow and lay it out for Ahmad in that room.' He said: So when I was in the room, something entered me and kept occurring to my mind: 'Who is like me? I am in the room of the intimate of Allah and on his bed.' So he called out to me, 'O Ahmad. Indeed, the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) visited Sa'sa'ah ibn Suhan and said: O Sa'sa'ah, do not make my visiting you a source of pride over your people, and humble yourself before Allah and Allah will raise you.'

en.summary: This narration from *Al-Kashi* highlights the spiritual etiquette of *adab* in the presence of the Imam, where even a companion of Ahmad ibn Abi Nasr's status experienced subtle self-reflection (*khawatir*) upon receiving the honor of sleeping in the Imam's tent. The Imam illustrates the virtue of humility by recounting how Imam Ali advised Sa'sa'ah ibn Suhan to avoid using the Imam's visit as a means of social superiority, instead seeking elevation through divine humility. This incident underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on internalizing humility rather than merely displaying external respect.
en.seo_question: What lesson did Imam Ali (peace be upon him) teach Sa'sa'ah ibn Suhan regarding humility and pride?

key_terms.الرِّضَا: Al-Rida (the title of Imam Musa al-Kadhim, the 7th Imam)
key_terms.أَمْسَى: To spend the evening or night
key_terms.صَعْصَعَةُ بْنُ صُوحَانَ: Sa'sa'ah ibn Suhan, a companion of Imam Ali
key_terms.عِيَادَة: Visiting (someone, especially when ill or honored)
